cost.question: How much does nursing care at home cost in Dehradun?
cost.answer: Our home nursing care services start from ₹1,500 per day for basic care and ₹2,500 per day for specialized care. This is 50-70% more affordable than hospital stays. We offer flexible pricing plans based on your specific needs and accept most insurance policies.

qualifications.question: What qualifications do your nurses have?
qualifications.answer: All our nurses are BSc/MSc Nursing qualified, registered with the Nursing Council of India, and have minimum 3 years of experience. They undergo regular training in the latest healthcare practices and are background verified for your safety and peace of mind.

responseTime.question: How quickly can you provide nursing care in Dehradun?
responseTime.answer: We can provide nursing care within 2-4 hours of your request across Dehradun. For emergency situations, our rapid response team is available 24/7 and can reach you within 1-2 hours depending on your location.

availability.question: Do you provide 24/7 nursing care services?
availability.answer: Yes, we provide round-the-clock nursing care services. You can choose from 8-hour, 12-hour, or 24-hour shifts based on your requirements. Our nurses work in rotating shifts to ensure continuous care without any gaps.

conditions.question: What medical conditions do you provide care for?
conditions.answer: We provide specialized nursing care for elderly patients, post-surgery recovery, chronic diseases (diabetes, hypertension, COPD), stroke rehabilitation, palliative care, wound care, medication management, and pediatric care. Our nurses are trained to handle various medical equipment and procedures.

coordination.question: Do you coordinate with doctors and hospitals?
coordination.answer: Yes, our nurses work closely with your treating doctors and maintain detailed care reports. We coordinate with leading hospitals in Dehradun including Max Hospital, Doon Hospital, Shri Mahant Indiresh Hospital, and other healthcare facilities for seamless healthcare management.
